screens.name: BackpackDim
screens.note: Darkens the hospital behind the bag: shown and hidden with it

screens.name: Backpack
screens.note: Hollow Ward's backpack: Tab, the HUD bag button or gamepad Select opens it

kids.name: Window
kids.note: The backpack: Tab or the HUD bag button opens it (Motion open); the game keeps running behind it

kids.name: Close
kids.note: Closes the backpack (also Esc, Tab or gamepad B)

kids.name: Vitals
kids.note: Health, sanity and carry weight, live while the bag is open

kids.name: Grid
kids.note: 12 slots, fixed: the bag never grows. SelectionGroup for the D-pad; a tap or A picks a slot and fills Details

kids.name: Selected
kids.note: The picked slot: an amber ring (it moves to the slot the player taps or focuses)

kids.name: Details
kids.note: The picked item: tapping or focusing a slot shows it here

kids.name: Glow
kids.note: The flashlight's warm light (flickers: Motion pulse)

kids.name: Flavor
kids.text: Flickers when they're close. 3 spare batteries in your bag.

kids.name: Use
kids.note: Uses the picked item (the server checks it): the flashlight toggles on

kids.name: Hint
kids.note: Key hint: the key on keyboard, the button glyph on a gamepad, hidden on touch (Ui.hint)

kids.name: Drop
kids.note: Drops it at your feet for a teammate to pick up
